eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Summit, UT; at 6:00 PM on AUG 9, 2026 Effective until 7:00 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Residents south of Franklin Canyon to Icy Springs/Wohali Way have been placed in 'Ready' Status to plan for possible evacuation due to the Rocky Canyon Fire. Be prepared to evacuate. This is NOT an evacuation order. Please gather important documents, prepare your vehicles, your animals, gather medicines, and an evacuation bag. Please do not call 911 for updates. Continue to monitor for official information available at https://www.summitcounty.info/emergency and Utah Fire Info.
